Class SceneLoader

java.lang.Object
handlers.SceneLoader
public class SceneLoader extends Object
SceneLoader is a utility class responsible for scene and window navigation.

This class centralizes all JavaFX navigation logic, including:

  • Loading and switching scenes
  • Opening new windows and modal dialogs
  • Closing windows
  • Displaying alert and confirmation dialogs

All methods are static and intended to be used by controllers throughout the application.

      public static void loadScene(javafx.event.ActionEvent event, String fxmlPath, String title)
      Loads a new scene into the current window.

    • switchScreen

      public static <T> void switchScreen(javafx.event.Event event, String fxmlPath, String title, Consumer<T> setupAction)
      Switches the current screen and allows controller initialization logic.

      This method hides the current window, loads a new scene, applies custom setup logic to the controller, and displays the new window.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the controller
      Parameters:
      event - the event that initiated the screen switch
      fxmlPath - the path to the FXML file to load
      title - the title of the new window
      setupAction - optional logic to run on the loaded controller
